newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney corporate, insurance law firms merge.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney corporate, insurance law firms merge.

text.p: Sydney banking and finance lawyers Dibbs Crowther and Osborne said on Monday they had merged with insurance and corporate law firm, Walsh James, effective immediately.

Dibbs Crowther said it had been acting for National Australia Bank (NAB) for more than 100 years while Walsh James had been acting for HIH Winterthur Insurance, which had just picked up the job of underwriting all of NAB's insurance work.
The client list of the merged firm also included; Citibank, the State Rail Authority and Colonial Mutual.

"We've put together a blend of legal experience and expertise in banking, insurance, superannuation and corporate law as a one-stop-shop for those who need a mix of opinions in a rapidly changing financial world," Dibbs Crowther senior partner Peter Everett said in a statement.
